sentences.text:
Arkan And 3 Ors vs State Of U.P. And Another on 15 February,
2023
Author: Saumitra Dayal Singh

Bench: Saumitra Dayal Singh
High Court Of Judicature At Allahabad
?Court No. - 75
Case :- Application U/S 482 No. - 32915 of 2019
Applicant :- Arkan And 3 Ors

entities.text: High Court Of Judicature At Allahabad
entities.label: COURT

sentences.text:
Opposite Party :- State of U.P. and Another
Counsel for Applicant :- Meraj Ahmad Khan,Ratnesh Kumar Tiwari
Counsel for Opposite Party :- G.A.
Hon'ble Saumitra Dayal Singh,J.
1.
Heard learned counsel for the applicants and learned A.G.A. for the State.

2. This application under Section 482 Cr.P.C. has been filed by the applicants to quash the charge-sheet 20 of 2019 dated 31.01.2019 arising out of Case Crime No. 521 of 2018 as well as cognizance order dated 17.07.2019 and proceedings of criminal case no. 1237 of 2019 (State Vs.
Arkan and others), under Sections 498A, 504 IPC and Section 3/4 D.P. Act, Police Station Bhojpur,
District-Moradabad pending in the court of Judicial Magistrate, Thakurdwara, Moradabad.
3. Learned counsel for the applicants submits that this court vide order dated 11.09.2019 had referred the matter to the Mediation and Conciliation Centre of this Court.
A settlement/agreement had been arrived at on 27.11.2020 between the parties.
A copy of the same is on record.

Perusal of the settlement/agreement thus reached reveals that the parties have amicably settled their dispute Arkan And 3 Ors vs State Of U.P. And Another on 15 February, 2023 Indian Kanoon - http://indiankanoon.org/doc/9299970/
1 and further agreed to withdraw the cases between them.

entities.text: Arkan And 3 Ors vs State Of U.P. And Another
entities.label: PRECEDENT

sentences.text: The said fact has been mentioned in para 7 and 8 of the settlement/agreement dated 27.11.2020.

Paragraph 7 and 8 of the said report reads as under:
"7.

The following settlement has been arrived at between the Parties hereto:-
a) That the parties have deiced to take Talaq and in this regard they have prepared a Talaqnama which is being annexed to this settlement for kind perusal of the Hon'ble Court.

b) That the parties have settled their dispute on the condition that the applicant-husband shall pay a permanent alimony including Stridhan of Rs.
01,85,000/- (Rupees One Lakh Eighty Five Thousand only)) to the wife by way of demand drafts which shall include all the financial claims including the amount of Mehar of Smt. Rabiya Parveen (O.P. No. 2- Wife).

The aforesaid amount shall be produced before the Centre installments and in compliance thereof Arkan (Applicant No. 1-Husband) had already been handed over the amount of Rs. 1,85,000/- (Rupees One Lakhs Eighty Five Thousand only) to Smt. Rabiya Parveen (O.P. No. 2-Wife) and she has acknowledged the receipt of the same.

c) That a demand draft bearing no. 062830 dated 21.11.2020 for Rs. 1,85,000/-
(Rupees One Lakh Eighty Five Thousand only) drawn on Central Bank of India in favour of wife namely Rabiya Parveen and which had already been handed over to the (O.P. No. 2- wife) on 25.11.2020 by the (Applicant No.1-Husband) and she has acknowledged the receipt of the same.

d) That it has been agreed between the parties that the all criminal and civil cases filed by them against each other shall be withdrawn/get quashed by them by taking appropriate steps before the Court/authorities concerned.
e) That it has been agreed between the parties that they shall not violate the terms and conditions of this settlement, otherwise the aggrieved party will be free to take legal course.

8. By signing this Agreement the Parties hereto state that the Application U/S 482 No. 32915 of 2019 and all disputes and differences in this regard have been amicably settled by the Parties hereto through the process of Conciliation/Mediation. "

4. Considering the facts and circumstances of the case and taking into account the settlement/agreement arrived at between the parties on 27.11.2020 before the Mediation and Conciliation Centre of this Court, the proceedings in the aforesaid case are hereby quashed.
